notes.title: On December 19th, we’re launching our new expansion, From the Ashes!

items.text: Return to Pandora as So'lek, a warrior haunted by his past. Struggling to find inner peace, his world is shattered once more as he faces a terrifying new enemy and fights to rescue his Sarentu family.

Take on the fight for the Western Frontier in an experience designed for third person gameplay – while remaining playable at your choice in first person. With a streamlined progression system, enhanced combat, and brutal Finishers, utilize stealth or go guns blazing to fight for your loved ones.

⚠️This update also introduces fixes for some of the reported issues following the December 5th 2.0 Title Update. Keep reading for a list of fixes, as well as existing known issues for both main game and From the Ashes.

On console, you will receive several downloads, to account for main game, both story packs and the expansion. Please make sure to download all available updates before starting the game, in order to have the best experience.
On PC, you will automatically get all the latest updates available in one comprehensive download.

For PC players, we recommend avoiding using mods to prevent additional unexpected crashes or glitches. Additionally, please ensure you are updated to the latest graphics drivers for your graphics card, as we have noticed older drivers can cause instability.⚠️
The total TU 2.5 patch sizes are estimated around 35 GB, with slight possible variations depending on platform.
\[All Platforms] Added a new option in the main menu for “From the Ashes”. This can be accessed without playing the main game’s story, allowing newcomers to jump right into the expansion.
\[All Platforms] Added “Character Overrides” and “Ikran Paint” sections in the customization screens. These can be used to equip new cosmetics added with From the Ashes.
\[All Platforms] Cosmetics now specify their compatibility with the main game and From the Ashes when selected.
\[All Platforms] Resolved the issue where loading would get stuck at 18%.
\[All Platforms] Resolved several high-occurrence crashes. We will continue to investigate additional crashes and will communicate about further fixes when we can.
\[All Platforms] The “Inspect” screen for ikran cosmetics now allows panning and rotation of the ikran. This is accessible by pressing the “Pose” button.
\[All Platforms] When changing body paints, the camera no longer zooms in on the character’s legs.
\[All Platforms] Fixed missing textures on trees and the environment, as well as flickering textures on character models.
\[All Platforms] Fixed the facial animation for the ikran call.
\[All Platforms] Previously purchased items are no longer missing from the inventory.
\[All Platforms] Eating a dish during “A Victory Celebration” no longer causes permanent debuffs.
\[All Platforms] Additional Na’vi language adjustments (e.g. P’asuk is now Pasuk)
\PC: Improved performance on 50-series Nvidia graphics cards.
These are issues we are aware of and actively investigating. We are following online conversation and tracking newly reported issues or bugs. Thank you for your feedback.
\[All Platforms] Story progression for From the Ashes is wrongfully displayed as 90%, even after completing all quests.
\[All Platforms] Several Journal entries are not unlocked despite meeting the unlock conditions.
\[All Platforms] Ikran Paints menu contents and equipped paint will disappear when entering a co-op session. To restore them, we recommend leaving the co-op session and restarting the game.
\[All Platforms] Bladewing Moth Wings may not upgrade item rarity if the game is played offline.
\[All Platforms] Item quantity appears as 0 in the mailbox for all items received from the Weekly Crafting Materials Pack. This is visual only, and you will still receive the items.
\[All Platforms] Some Clan Contribution quests do not properly update and cannot be completed.

\[All Platforms] Crafting materials and cooked meals cannot be claimed from the Mail screen if the player already has one in the Pouch. It also displays the message “Item is already claimed”, which is erroneous. The items can be claimed if the one in the Pouch is used.
\[All Platforms] Crafting materials and food dish containers can be looted when the pouch is full, causing the loot contained inside to disappear.
\[All Platforms] Songcord and character models do not appear in the Songcord menu.
\[All Platforms] Several UI / Localization issues.
\PC: Deleting a saved game, then pressing “continue” on another save using the keyboard will launch a new game instead. This issue does not appear when using the mouse instead of the keyboard.
\PC: Current selected Windows refresh rate is not recognized – the game always displays with your monitor's maximum supported refresh rate.
\PC: The loading screen for transitioning to The Skybreaker story pack takes longer than intended.
\PC: Using Ray Reconstruction with the DLSS4 transformer model may cause slight visual issues at certain points.
\PC: When confirming video settings, the pop-up window’s “Revert” option does not work as intended.

notes.title: The Third Person Update for Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™ will be available tomorrow (December 5th) at 9AM CET / 8 AM UTC / 00:00 PT for all players! As you return to Pandora, share your journey with us through in-game photo mode shots – use the hashtag #AvatarFrontiers!

items.text: Our 2-year anniversary is almost here! We’re hoping you’ll celebrate alongside us by diving back into the Western Frontier, in third person or New Game+.

With Title Update 2.0, all players can enjoy the game from a third person view, letting you see the world from a new perspective! You can switch between third person and first person easily – by default:
Press the J key on PC.
Hold the touchpad on PS5.
Hold the “View” button on Xbox Series X/S.

Alongside third person, you’ll also be able to experience Frontiers of Pandora’s main story in New Game+. When you replay the main story in New Game+, you carry over all of your gear and skills from your regular (completed) playthrough, and get access to a new skill tree for the Sarentu, as well as higher level gear, which you will need to defeat New Game+’s stronger enemies. To access New Game+:
Load a saved game where you’ve completed the final mission in the main story (“Last Strike”).
Open the Options menu – you should see a “New Game+” option at the top of the menu.
After selecting “New Game+”, you will be prompted to select a Save Slot which will become the New Game+ save slot. Once that’s done, your New Game+ journey will begin.
\[All Platforms] Added an option for a Third Person perspective.
\[All Platforms] Added New Game+.

\[All Platforms] To improve the Na’vi language accuracy in the game, we’ve introduced several changes to text. The most impactful one is that “Eetu” is now called “Itu” to reflect a more accurate spelling of the character’s name.
\[All Platforms] Fixed missing landmarks on the Map.
\[All Platforms] Various minor fixes.
\PC: Introduced Nvidia DLSS 4 and AMD FSR 4 upscaling options.
These are issues we are aware of and actively investigating.
\[All Platforms] Character Overrides menu is available but empty – it will be populated when From the Ashes releases.
\[All Platforms] If you are trying to restore a New Game+ save files from the “Restore Save” menu, the saves available to restore are not clearly marked as “New Game+”
\[All Platforms] During the quest “The Wandering Clan”, the direhorse occasionally gets stuck when dismounted and remounted.
\[All Platforms] You can throw grenades as you fire the Staff Sling.
\[All Platforms] In co-op, Ping icons persist in the world instead of disappearing.
\[All Platforms] Various UI and localization issues.
\PC: Occasional crash when exiting the game if Frame Generation is enabled
\PC: Crash on startup when XeSS Frame generation is enabled
\PC: Frame Generation cannot be activated while the Steam Overlay is on.
\PC: FSR3 Frame Generation causes stuttering when used in Borderless Fullscreen.
\PC: Switching from Borderless to Fullscreen while Frame Generation is on causes the framerate to drop significantly.

\[All Platforms] Fixed missing landmarks on the Map.

notes.title: Title Update 1.4 for Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™ will be deployed on April 15th at 8:00 UTC / 10:00 CEST / 1:00 PST

items.text: This update brings important fixes and updates, which you can find below:
PS5 – 5 GB
Xbox Series X/S – 4.82 GB
PC – 6.79 GB

Hunter’s Guide has been updated! You can now mark entries as favorites and filter through them. Additionally, we also include an “Undiscovered Entries” filter, clearly displaying the entries you’re missing. Keep an eye out for missing entries while you’re playing.

We’ve added a new tab to Photo Mode – “Style” – where you can find the “Comic Book” toggle, allowing you to capture hyper-stylized shots of your game. Share your shots using #AvatarFrontiers – can't wait to see what you come up with!

The “Gameplay” menu category has some new options: “Gathering Controls Tutorial” – which enables you to more specifically choose how the on-screen gathering tutorials appear during gameplay.: “Quest Marker” allows you to choose how the Quest Marker is displayed in the world. You can select between having the marker be permanently visible, or make it appear only when using Na’vi Senses.
The map has been updated to improve the visibility of icons and markers;
Pinned ingredients will now appear highlighted when nearby, making them easier to spot!
In the Settings menu, you can find a new setting in the User Interface category called "HUD Contrast". This setting can help improve the readability of the HUD.
Arrows will no longer exclusively hit center mass when using a Shortbow, Longbow or Heavy Bow with the Reflex Shot perk;
Various UI improvements;
Various back-end stability improvements;
Several quest-related fixes;
Fixes to the left-handed input presets;

Fixes to localization in several instances.: Surprise! With this update, players will receive two new ikran patterns in their inventory: First Light & Dreamer’s Run! We’ll make sure to keep an eye out for your awesome Photo Mode shots 💙.

items.text: We have just deployed a small update to address a few minor issues. The update is for PC only and brings improvements to stability.
The update is about ~240MB in size. Other platforms are not affected.

notes.title: The second story pack for Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™, Secrets of the Spires, is available now for owners of the Season Pass!

items.text: Epic aerial battles await in the Spires of the Clouded Forest, a spectacular new mountainous region in Pandora's Western Frontier.
Explore and discover a fresh open world, built to elevate the thrill of flying on your ikran!
Sabotage RDA aerial convoys with new ikran skills and a brand-new mounted weapon.
Meet a secluded Na'vi clan and join them in their fight against a new RDA threat in the Spires region.
Get lost in the verticality of this new region, filled with canyons and caves, where unexpected dangers lurk in the shadows.

*The story pack continues the events of the main game. You can opt for skipping ahead to the start of the Secrets of the Spires story pack content. This will skip ahead through the events of the main story and equip you with everything you need to experience the story pack content. To begin, go to your quest log and select the quest "Anufi’s Favor”.

notes.title: A new map area, Spires of the Clouded Forest, is available

items.text: Play through an all-new story campaign, side quests, and new activities.
Navigate and discover new biomes like the Tangled Peaks, Splintered Arches, Warrior’s Rise and more!
Deepen the bond with your ikran and unlock new skills and gear.
Encounter new aerial threats and master your abilities to overcome them.
Interact with new flora and wildlife and discover new ways of gathering and traversal!
[All Platforms] You can now use skill points to unlock and upgrade several new skills for your ikran, such as Ikran Smash, Launch, Flares and more!
60 FPS Quality Mode – The game will run at 60 FPS using Quality Mode on Playstation 5 Pro
Increased internal resolution - The increased hardware performance allows the game to reach both higher FPS and higher rendering resolution, resulting in increased resolution in certain scenarios.

PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) - Integration of the new machine learning-based temporal upscaler PSSR, which uses the new ML-hardware of the PS5 Pro, bringing better quality and performance.

PC: We will deploy a temporary fix for players who were experiencing issues playing on Windows 11 24H2. Please note that you may experience some performance issues while we work on a more permanent fix. As soon as it is ready, we will let you know. Thank you for your understanding.
[All Platforms] Warning message does not match the situation when trying to start the quest Anufi’s Favor in co-op without the player having completed the main story.
[All Platforms] Missing preview for ikran patterns while having any ikran body cosmetic override equipped in the in-game store.
[All Platforms] Map icons and overlays load slowly after every game load or respawn.
[All Platforms] “Responsibility” songcord bead has the same icon as “Our Reclamation”.
[All Platforms] Lens flare effects are present on every RDA light source.
[All Platforms] Infinite loading occurs for co-op players after the credits scene ends after playing “The Fight for Home” quest.
[All Platforms] Player character dialogue lines are too quiet while inside MTR Base Echo in the “Into the Mountain” quest.
[All Platforms] “Penance” quest cannot be completed due to the player character not being able to interact with the quest objective.
[All Platforms] Bonus damage for hitting the chiroptera’s weakspot does not properly apply.
[All Platforms] Players randomly receive rewards without looting or completing any quests.
[All Platforms] Missing “drop” button for ikran gear and Crossbow mods in the ikran menu.
[All Platforms] Hunter’s Guide mentions Healer's Hollow as a location for gathering legendary Dark Root, on the map this location is called Echoing Cavern.

topNew: Play through an all-new story campaign, side quests, and new activities.
Navigate and discover new biomes like the Tangled Peaks, Splintered Arches, Warrior’s Rise and more!
Deepen the bond with your ikran and unlock new skills and gear.

items.text: This update brings important fixes and updates, which you can find below:
Important: We're aware of an ongoing issue affecting PC players after the 24H2 Windows Update. We are working on identifying both the root cause and its resolution. Thanks for your understanding.
Owners of The Sky Breaker will no longer be locked out of their saves.
Adjusted UI elements to more accurately indicate requirements for starting The Sky Breaker story pack.
Custom key binding settings will no longer reset on game restart.
A Match Made in Pandora quest is no longer impossible to complete.
Familiar Echoes: Part 4 quest is no longer impossible to complete due to a missing NPC.

Remedied issues where players had not received their Ubisoft+ monthly cosmetic rewards. Those eligible should now have the Upper Plains Rider Weapon Set, Rebellion Weapon Set and Resistance Scavenger Weapon Set available in-game.
Fixed additional crashes and issues.
Updated the menu visuals ahead of our new story pack, Secrets of the Spires.

topNew: Updated the menu visuals ahead of our new story pack, Secrets of the Spires.

items.text: Update: We have successfully restored all language packs - they should now be available for download. Thank you for your patience!
The first story pack for Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™, The Sky Breaker, is now available for owners of the Season Pass!
A new map area, the Heart of the Plains is available:
Play through an all-new story campaign, side quests and new activities.
Explore brand new environments, such as the Prism Fields, Feathered Grasslands, Stone Rapids - and more!
Discover new Heartlands direhorse variants that are unique to this part of the Western Frontier.
Encounter new enemy archetypes such as the AMP Defender and new RDA lieutenants protecting RDA Command Stations throughout the new area.
Participate in the Great Games with various challenges to test your skills!
Purchased ikran patterns will be available on all saves, instead of being locked to a single playthrough.
Improved AI behavior.
The Staff Sling has been balanced to better adapt to the player's level.
You can now sprint for longer.
You can now jump more consistently.
You can now use skill points to permanently improve your character's damage, energy and health up to 4 times each after you have completed the main quest storyline.
You can now progress up to rank 25.

We have made some improvements to random loot and rewards. Loot now scales better with your character progression and random loot is more likely to be relevant for your slots most in need of an upgrade.
Added a new Legendary rarity category.
The direhorse can now perform a Great Jump.
It's now possible for the camera to switch shoulders while riding by performing a melee attack input.
Improvements to the riding camera, handling and animation.
While mounted on a direhorse you can now ride through deeper waters more effectively.

topNew: The Staff Sling has been balanced to better adapt to the player's level.
You can now sprint for longer.
